scope: Six pending protein-name candidates from the complete 720-term screen; eight existing CARD claims in eight records.

mcr-original.locator: Letter, functional-result paragraph and concluding paragraph; HTML table interpretations only
mcr-original.summary: The letter reports no independent polymyxin-resistance effect for its historical mcr-4.2 label, despite variable isolate phenotypes.

mcr-followup.locator: Text, naming paragraph and functional-result conclusions preceding Figure 2; figures not visually reviewed
mcr-followup.summary: The later study identifies the renamed MCR-4.3 allele and reports negative colistin-resistance and lipid-A-modification results in its tested contexts.

mcr-naming.locator: Indexed naming proposal; detailed naming table unavailable through the web reader
mcr-naming.summary: This PMID identifies the nomenclature proposal, not the separate AAC.00649-18 functional study. The naming relation is independently explicit in that later primary report.

mcr-later-context.locator: Results and Discussion, initial isolate-identification subsection; supplements not inspected
mcr-later-context.summary: A later report describes resistant Acinetobacter and susceptible Shewanella carriers. Carrier phenotype alone does not resolve allele causality or overturn context-specific negative evidence.

msrc.summary: The authors report susceptibility changes but allow a downstream-gene contribution; the proposed efflux mechanism remains a hypothesis.

eatav.locator: Reciprocal-replacement results, Table 3 headers and Discussion; no quantitative AST extraction
eatav.summary: Functional genetic evidence supports an LSAP phenotype. The tested pleuromutilin was tiamulin; biochemical transport mechanism remained unresolved.

eatav-genome.locator: Aus0004 reference-genome results; also matched by cached UniProt bibliography
eatav-genome.summary: Aus0004 is reference-genome context, not evidence that it is the experimental resistant derivative in the later allele study.

ddl-primary.locator: Abstract; full results and figures not obtained
ddl-primary.summary: The study concerns inactivated ligases in glycopeptide-dependent clinical isolates; generic ddl presence is not the assessed resistance event.

ddl-review.summary: This is secondary glycopeptide-resistance context, not a second allele-specific primary experiment.

tmrb.locator: Abstract; full paper available as advertised PDF but not inspected here
tmrb.summary: The abstract supports TmrB ATP-binding and membrane association, but does not resolve a complete substrate-transport mechanism or this reference strain's experimental identity.

qnrb65.locator: Journal issue 58(2), letter identity; no allele-specific results obtained
qnrb65.summary: Citation identity agrees; the exact QnrB65 isolate, allele and phenotype relationship remains unreviewed.

ARO:3004695.assessment: Retain context-specific negative functional evidence, not a universal inactivity claim. Neither carrier phenotype nor a name match grounds an exact colistin-component effect.
ARO:3004695.next_action: Review remaining later functional reports before a source-owned qualification; preserve contrasting contexts, original provenance, and the separation of colistin A and B.

ARO:3002819.assessment: Keep the locus association separate from exclusive gene causality, efflux proof, and exact tested-allele identity.
ARO:3002819.next_action: Check later mechanistic evidence and compound form before a source-owned qualification; do not invent the missing native gene field.

ARO:3003761.assessment: The parent pleuromutilin record is not interchangeable with a tested derivative. A reference genome is not a tested allele or subject.
ARO:3003761.next_action: Resolve exact compound evidence and the experimental accession crosswalk before promoting this reference or curating an activity observation.

ARO:3003970.assessment: Keep a generic enzyme reference distinct from the specific dependence context; primary results remain incomplete.
ARO:3003970.next_action: Review primary results and the source term's entity scope before assigning any experimental allele.

ARO:3004285.assessment: Retain the strain-ranked reference and separate species ancestor without assigning either to a tested subject.
ARO:3004285.next_action: Review the full primary paper and exact tunicamycin form; do not transfer a different term's explicit CARD cross-reference.

ARO:3002777.assessment: The name, citation and reference taxon still do not identify a measured allele-specific resistance claim.
ARO:3002777.next_action: Obtain the primary result context through an authorized available route before selecting any biological subject or genome.

retrieval_limitations: The web reader returned internal errors, without HTTP status, for initial opens of QnrB65, msrC, eatAv, the reference-genome paper, the ddl full-text page, and the Europe PMC metadata query. These are not documented HTTP 403 responses.
Publisher-indexed text was subsequently available for msrC, eatAv and the reference-genome paper. QnrB65 opens remained unavailable. The naming-proposal find operations also returned internal errors.
No native primary article files were cached; primary assessments are dated human-readable web-text observations, not offline replay of article bodies.
No figures, supplements or rendered tables were visually verified. No MIC values or resistance breakpoints were newly curated.
The nomenclature proposal's exact PMID-to-DOI identity was checked against existing local Europe PMC discovery metadata. No NCBI request was made.

A later clinical Acinetobacter report at https://academic.oup.com/jac/article/75/1/60/5580312 remains an unreviewed lead after a web-reader internal error; no universal MCR-4.3 activity conclusion is made.
All inherited access holds remain in force. No held article was retried, and NCBI AST/#1040 and reuse-terms review remain deferred.
